def smoothplan(component,inset=2.6,spacing=2.8):
 dist=distance_transform_edt(LABELS==component)
 center=np.array(np.unravel_index(np.argmax(dist),dist.shape))[::-1].astype(float)
 rings=[]
 for level in np.arange(inset,dist.max(),spacing)[::-1]:
  for c in contours(dist,level):rings.append((level,c))
 cur=center;paths=[center[None,:]];last_t=None
 for level in sorted(set(l for l,c in rings),reverse=True):
  todo=[c for l,c in rings if l==level]
  while todo:
   choices=[np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(c-cur,axis=1)) for c in todo]
   idx=int(np.argmin([np.linalg.norm(c[k]-cur) for c,k in zip(todo,choices)]));c=todo.pop(idx);k=choices[idx]
   c=c[:-1] if np.linalg.norm(c[0]-c[-1])<1e-3 else c;k=min(k,len(c)-1)
   c=np.vstack([c[k:],c[:k]])
   lens=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(c,axis=0),axis=1))]
   shift=np.argmin(abs(lens-min(20,lens[-1]*.3)))
   c=np.vstack([c[shift:],c[:shift],c[shift:shift+1]])
   t0=last_t if last_t is not None else c[0]-cur;t0=t0/(np.linalg.norm(t0)+1e-9)
   t1=c[min(5,len(c)-1)]-c[0];t1=t1/(np.linalg.norm(t1)+1e-9)
   n=np.linalg.norm(c[0]-cur);t=np.linspace(0,1,max(4,int(n*2)))[:,None]
   ctrl0=cur+t0*n*.4;ctrl1=c[0]-t1*n*.4
   b=(1-t)**3*cur+3*(1-t)**2*t*ctrl0+3*(1-t)*t*t*ctrl1+t**3*c[0]
   if np.min(dist[np.rint(b[:,1]).astype(int),np.rint(b[:,0]).astype(int)])<inset-.8:
    b=connect(cur,c[0],dist,min_d=inset-.8)
   paths.extend([b,c]);cur=c[-1];last_t=c[-1]-c[max(0,len(c)-6)]
 path=np.vstack(paths);keep=np.r_[True,np.linalg.norm(np.diff(path,axis=0),axis=1)>1e-5]
 return path[keep]
